descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B19 · P1 · 已知

保留 / 清理没有按 UAT 3.6 实现：13 小时的重点事项、37 小时的任务 / 交接 / 体征都还在；医生不打开 app 就不清；超过 500 个病人时会漏清

票：TFA-94699 in progress · 算 QA bug：否（票在做） · 在哪发现：本地

注：一个根因让 19 条用例都挂了；保留时长本身怎么定，见待决策 D6

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

思路 / Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S23 「从没处理过、处理后又改过、或 Save Note 失败留下原始文字的查房前文字，也会被删掉」 Pre-round text never processed, edited after processing, or left raw by a failed Save Note is still deleted

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 Hospital pre-round text clears at 12 h: pre-round text seeded at 13 h is deleted.（UAT OAT-04 step 1；UAT 3.6；TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: pre-round text 12 h)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U9 Nursing Home keeps the last two visits: notes, transcripts and medication events from older visits are deleted; the chronic medication list and open tasks persist until changed; …（UAT OAT-04 (B)；UAT 3.6 (Nursing Home: pre-round 12 h, encounter 12 h, note 18 h, last two visits)；UAT 3.3；TFA-94699 AC 1 (Nursing Home line)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U11 Live patient data never survives past its window: once an item clears, no copy of it remains anywhere live (other fields of the chart, dated histories, the patient-list row, handoffs, drafts). …（UAT OAT-04 Expected 2；UAT 3.7 (retention claim)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Through the aging helper (or backend seeding; rounding:update accepts these stamps): Hospital P1 - pre-round text 'RET-PRE-912' typed 37 h ago (preRoundEditedAt), never processed (notesProcessedAt unset). P2 - processed 40 h ago, then edited 37 h ago ('RET-PRE-913'). …

When The purge runs; raw documents read with admin access

Then At 37 h no Hospital marker (912, 913, 914) is left in preRoundNotes or rawPreRoundNotes. The 13 h shapes and the Nursing Home resident are reported against Q2

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 3.7 retention claim ('no live Hospital patient data survives more than 36 hours') and OAT-04 Expected 2 (U11): a Hospital marker present at 37 h = Fail whatever Q2 says. The 13 h shapes and the Nursing Home shape (the 36 h claim is Hospital-only) are Pass or Fail per the Q2 answer, both readings quoted until then. The Save-Noted 12 h case is S01 / S07

在哪跑：本地 retention（改时钟看保留期）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（blocked）
